basics.name: Zhuohua Liu
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate in Integrated Circuits
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at Beihang University specializing in AI for EDA, analog circuit optimization, and transistor sizing using Bayesian optimization and machine learning.

highlights: School of Integrated Circuits Science and Engineering

awards.title: 1st Prize, National Final — 2025 China Postgraduate IC Innovation Competition, EDA Elite Challenge Contest
awards.summary: National first prize in the EDA Elite Challenge Contest.

publications.name: DIVE: Dynamic Information-Guided Variable Expansion for Deeper Analog Circuit Optimization
publications.summary: Proposed DIVE, achieving up to 21.11x simulation reduction and 2.69x performance improvement. (1st author)

publications.name: KATO: Knowledge Alignment and Transfer for Transistor Sizing of Different Design and Technology
publications.summary: Efficient knowledge alignment and transfer framework for analog transistor sizing, reducing simulation cost by up to 50%. (Student 2nd author)

publications.name: OpenYield: An Open-Source SRAM Yield Analysis and Optimization Benchmark Suite
publications.summary: Realistic SRAM yield analysis and optimization benchmark with parasitic-aware circuit generation. (Co-1st author)
